definitions.explanation: The softer red glow that follows {夕焼|ゆうや}け in the western sky after the sun has set. Used mainly in the fixed pair {夕焼|ゆうや}けこやけ rather than on its own.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕焼|ゆうや}け→夕焼け：05045_yuuyake⟧こやけ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The sunset and afterglow are beautiful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{童謡|どうよう}→童謡：03480_douyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧「⟦{夕焼|ゆうや}け→夕焼け：05045_yuuyake⟧こやけ」⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歌|うた}った→歌う：00684_utau⟧。
examples.english: We all sang the children's song "Yūyake Koyake" together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕焼|ゆうや}け→夕焼け：05045_yuuyake⟧こやけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見上|みあ}げ→見上げる：04567_miageru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{帰|かえ}って→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧いった。
examples.english: Looking up at the glowing evening sky, the children headed home.

notes:
Almost never used alone — it appears as the second half of ⟦{夕焼|ゆうや}け→夕焼け：05045_yuuyake⟧こやけ, where it functions partly as a sound-pattern echo of ⟦{夕焼|ゆうや}け→夕焼け：05045_yuuyake⟧. Famous from the children's song "⟦{夕焼|ゆうや}け→夕焼け：05045_yuuyake⟧こやけ," which plays from public-address systems in many Japanese neighborhoods at 5 p.m. to signal that children should head home.

FORMS:
- ⟦{夕焼|ゆうや}け→夕焼け：05045_yuuyake⟧こやけ: sunset (with afterglow) — the standard pair
- ⟦{夕焼|ゆうや}け→夕焼け：05045_yuuyake⟧: sunset glow — the bright red glow at sunset itself
- ⟦{朝焼|あさや}け→朝焼け：04655_asayake⟧: morning glow — the dawn equivalent
